description: This file defines a React functional component named U2FAddDeviceView for adding U2F (Universal 2nd Factor) devices within the preferences/security pane of a web application. It manages user input, handles device addition logic, and renders a modal dialog with input fields and actions.

methods.name: handleDeviceNameChange
methods.description: Callback to update deviceName state when user types or modifies the device name input field.

methods.name: handleAddDeviceClick
methods.description: Async handler triggered when user clicks to add a device; validates input, calls authenticator addition, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Function to close the modal, toggling the modal visibility off.
